pr.title: fix(core): retry mails rejected with a temporary SMTP error after a longer delay
pr.body: Some SMTP servers answer with a temporary 4xx code (greylisting, rate limits) and accept the mail only after a few minutes. The transport retry backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) is used up long before that, so those mails end in the failed transport. `SendMailHandler` now turns a 4xx answer into a `RecoverableMessageHandlingException` with a five-minute retry delay; permanent 5xx errors are rethrown unchanged.
pr.author: synthetic
